agents.name: Storyline Architect
agents.claim: Parcel Alibi has the clearest obstacle: both partners want their small indulgence understood without being judged.
agents.objection: It can become shopping content if the boxes are the subject.
agents.repair: Make the boxes statements in a relationship courtroom, then turn the judgment into shared alibi.

agents.name: Contrarian Critic
agents.claim: The route survives the perfect-husband objection because both people are guilty.
agents.objection: Avoid money scolding, shopping shame, or making one partner look irresponsible.
agents.repair: Keep the tone petty, warm, and mutual: this is about tiny married-life mischief, not finance.

agents.name: Retention Analyst
agents.claim: The second doorbell is a strong middle re-engagement beat.
agents.objection: Slide 1 must not be a soft thesis.
agents.repair: Use a contradiction hook: 'Some couples do not receive parcels. They give statements.'

agents.name: Visual Director
agents.claim: Doorway, boxes, defensive hands, frozen faces, and hiding movement make clean silent panels.
agents.repair: Vary camera distance: doorway wide, box close-up, reaction two-shot, delivery silhouette, crouched hiding, sofa payoff.

agents.name: Copy Chief
agents.claim: The copy can stay short and scene-native.
agents.objection: Too much courtroom language may become clever copy instead of real behavior.
agents.repair: Use spoken lines: 'It was necessary.', 'Mine is for work.', 'Doorbell again.', 'Hide yours first.'

agents.name: Algorithm / Brand Strategist
agents.claim: The send reason is strong because parcels, guilty faces, and mutual alibi are widely recognizable.
agents.objection: Wallet and money-adjacent lanes were rejected.
agents.repair: Keep it as parcel/online-order domestic comedy, not wallet control or budget caretaker content.

agents.name: Harsh Final Selector
agents.claim: Parcel Alibi beats Charger Custody because it has fresher visual proof, stronger middle escalation, and better brand/world expansion.
agents.objection: Proceed only if the final line is earned by action.
agents.repair: Final thesis: 'Maybe love is one shared alibi.'
